title: Discovery message on stage
slide_intent: Use a few oversized words behind a speaker because a stage message must remain recognizable at a distance.
strategic_value: Spotify can reinforce discovery as a public promise through white type on an energetic green portrait backdrop.
demonstration: A presenter stands before cropped oversized white discovery-related text and a green photographic background.
practical_value: Evaluate how much headline cropping a stage backdrop can tolerate beside a speaker.

content_islands.name: Backdrop
content_islands.spec: Large white letterforms span the green photographic wall; the crop does not expose the full message.

content_islands.name: Presenter
content_islands.spec: The figure occupies the lower foreground and provides human scale.

reference_purposes.Expression: A presenter stands before cropped oversized white discovery-related text and a green photographic background.
reference_purposes.Application: The source shows this identity in the pictured campaign or event setting.
